title.en: Switzerland to vote on plan to cap population at 10 million
title.zh: 瑞士将投票决定是否将人口上限设为1000万

summary.en: Switzerland is set to vote on a proposal to cap its population at 10 million. Proponents from the right-wing Swiss People's Party frame it as a 'sustainability initiative,' while opponents argue it would lead to social disruption.
summary.zh: 瑞士将就一项将人口上限设定为1000万的提案进行投票。右翼的瑞士人民党支持者称之为“可持续发展倡议”，而反对者则认为这将导致社会混乱。

body.en:
Can a country put a fixed limit on its population? That is the question Switzerland will be answering on Sunday when voters go the polls to decide on a proposal to cap their population at 10 million.

The move is backed by the right-wing Swiss People's Party, which describes it as a "sustainability initiative" aimed at easing pressure on housing, public services and the environment.

The Swiss government, all other major parties, business leaders and trade unions have dubbed the proposal a "chaos initiative", arguing it will deprive hospitals and hotels of much needed staff, and damage hard-won relations with the European Union, leaving non-EU member Switzerland isolated in a very risky world.

Switzerland's population has grown rapidly since 2002, when it stood at 7.3 million. Now it is 9.1 million, 27% of whom are foreign residents.

Many voters are concerned by overcrowded trains, expensive apartments and rising health costs.

They suggest voters are inching towards a no vote by a wafer thin margin, with 52% opposed - but polls remain divided, with 45% saying they are in favour of the proposal and a significant number of voters still undecided.

Helin Genis and Nils Fiechter have a good deal in common, but their diametrically opposed views on limiting the Swiss population are indicative of the polarised nature of this referendum.

Both are young local politicians from immigrant families. Fiechter is 29 and Genis is 31. Helin's parents are originally from Turkey, while Nils's mother is from Canada and he holds dual citizenship.

"We have lost control," complains Fiechter, who represents the Swiss People's Party in canton Bern's parliament. "Unchecked immigration is leading to Switzerland no longer being Switzerland."

He believes Switzerland's problems, which he says include a "housing shortage, gridlocked traffic, overburdened schools and strained social services", are a direct result of immigration.

Genis, who is a Social Democrat elected to Bern city council, dismisses these arguments as scapegoating.

She tells BBC News: "It is not migrants who determine rent levels. It is not migrants who raise health insurance premiums. Nor is it migrants who make political decisions on housing, infrastructure or social investment."

Viewing problems '"through the lens of migration does not lead to solutions, but to division", she adds.

For voters who have not yet made up their minds, a key question is how exactly a population cap would work.

Putting a hard limit on the number of residents is not a measure any other country has tried, although China, through its now abandoned one-child limit, did try to slow population growth.

body.zh: 一个国家可以对其人口数量进行固定限制吗？这就是瑞士将于周日回答的问题，届时选民将进行民意调查，以决定一项将人口上限限制在 1000 万的提案。 此举得到了右翼瑞士人民党的支持，该党将其描述为一项“可持续倡议”，旨在缓解住房、公共服务和环境的压力。 瑞士政府、所有其他主要政党、商界领袖和工会将该提案称为“混乱倡议”，认为它将剥夺医院和酒店急需的员工，并损害与欧盟来之不易的关系，使非欧盟成员国瑞士在一个非常危险的世界中被孤立。 自2002年以来，瑞士人口增长迅速，当时人口达到730万。现在是910万，其中27%是外国居民。 许多选民对过度拥挤的火车、昂贵的公寓和不断上涨的医疗费用感到担忧。 他们表示，选民们正以微弱的优势逐渐走向否决，其中 52% 的人表示反对，但民意调查仍然存在分歧，45% 的人表示支持该提案，还有大量选民尚未做出决定。 Helin Genis 和 Nils Fiechter 有很多共同点，但他们在限制瑞士人口问题上截然相反的观点表明了这次公投的两极分化。 两人都是来自移民家庭的年轻当地政客。费希特今年 29 岁，吉尼斯 31 岁。赫林的父母来自土耳其，尼尔斯的母亲来自加拿大，他拥有双重国籍。 “我们已经失去了控制，”伯尔尼州议会代表瑞士人民党的费希特抱怨道。 “不受控制的移民正在导致瑞士不再是瑞士。” 他认为，瑞士的问题，包括“住房短缺、交通拥堵、学校负担过重和社会服务紧张”，都是移民的直接结果。 当选为伯尔尼市议会议员的社会民主党人杰尼斯认为这些论点是替罪羊。 她告诉英国广播公司新闻：“决定租金水平的不是移民。提高医疗保险费的不是移民。住房、基础设施或社会投资方面的政治决定也不是移民。” 她补充说，“通过移民的视角看待问题不会带来解决方案，而是会导致分裂”。 对于尚未下定决心的选民来说，一个关键问题是人口上限究竟如何运作。 对居民数量实行硬性限制是任何其他国家都没有尝试过的措施，尽管中国通过现已放弃的一胎限制确实试图减缓人口增长。 瑞士提案称，2050年之前人口不得超过1000万，并命令政府一旦...

reflection.en: Debates about national population limits often raise complex questions about resources and identity. This ancient wisdom reminds us to consider the dignity and welcome due to all who seek a home among us, treating them as we would wish to be treated. It calls nations to remember their own histories and extend compassion to those who are new to the land.
reflection.zh: 关于国家人口限制的辩论，常常引发关于资源和身份认同的复杂问题。这古老的智慧提醒我们，要思考所有寻求在我们中间安家的人所应得的尊严和欢迎，待他们如同我们希望被对待一样。它呼吁各国铭记自己的历史，并向那些新来者施予怜悯。

title.en: Israel carries out air strikes on Lebanon, state media says, as Iran claims deal with US near
title.zh: 官方媒体称，以色列对黎巴嫩进行空袭，伊朗声称与美国即将达成协议

summary.en: The strikes come as Iran's foreign minister says a deal to end fighting with the US is close.

body.en:
Israel has carried out air strikes in the south of Lebanon after ordering people to leave about 20 locations, Lebanese state media has said.

At least one person has been killed following a strike on the town of Marrakeh, in Lebanon's Tyre district, according to the Lebanese National News Agency.

Israel's prime minister had previously warned his country would strike Hezbollah if it continues attacks against northern Israel.

The strikes come as Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, whose country is mediating talks between the US and Iran, wrote on X "we are closer to a peace deal than ever before". Finalisation is "likely expected in the next 24 hours", he added.

Iran's foreign minister said earlier that a deal to end fighting with the US is close. The agreement also envisages an end to the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah in Lebanon, Seyed Abbas Araghchi also said.

Araghchi said the deal includes reopening the Strait of Hormuz and told state TV it includes the lifting of a US blockade of Iran. However, he said talks on Iran's nuclear programme would begin later.

US officials have confirmed some of the details of the agreement, saying economic benefits for Iran would depend on Tehran meeting its obligations.

Previous reports from the US have suggested Lebanon may not be part of this deal - with Iran reportedly insisting on it.

The war began with US and Israeli strikes across Iran on 28 February, prompting Iran to attack Israel and US-allied states in the Gulf - as well as effectively closing the Strait of Hormuz, a key shipping route for the world's oil and liquefied natural gas.

Despite having agreed a ceasefire in April, the US and Iran have exchanged intermittent fire, including two rounds of tit-for-tat strikes this week.

US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he had cancelled "scheduled attacks" against Iran, because negotiators had "just made a great settlement" - a deal that was likely be to signed imminently.

On Friday, Iranian media published some details from the alleged 14-point deal which Trump said had "nothing to do with the terms that were agreed to" and "bears no relation to the truth".

A few hours later, Pakistan's prime minister said the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the US and Iran had been agreed and awaited finalising.

On Saturday, Sharif wrote on X that his country "is preparing for the electronic signing of the peace deal... followed by technical level talks next week".

Iran's Araghchi was quoted in state media saying there are "supporters and opponents" of the latest terms of the deal among Iran's top security body, the Supreme National Security Council.

title.en: Three teenagers arrested over death of man in Essex
title.zh: 三名青少年因埃塞克斯郡男子死亡案被捕

summary.en: Three teenagers, including a 14-year-old boy, have been arrested on suspicion of murdering a 21-year-old man in Central Park, Chelmsford, Essex. Emergency services responded to the critically injured man.
summary.zh: 埃塞克斯郡切尔姆斯福德中央公园一名21岁男子被发现受重伤后死亡，三名青少年（包括一名14岁男孩）因涉嫌谋杀被捕。

body.en:
Three teenagers, including a 14-year-old boy, have been arrested on suspicion of murdering a 21-year-old man in a park in Essex.

Emergency services attended Central Park in Chelmsford at about 7pm on Friday, where the victim was found with critical injuries.

Essex police said the 21-year-old died at the scene, despite the efforts of paramedics to save him. An investigation began immediately and quickly led officers to an address in Auckland Close, Chelmsford.

A spokesperson for the force said the suspects, aged 14, 17 and 18, were arrested shortly afterwards and remained in custody for questioning.

The victim’s family have been informed and are receiving support from specially trained officers.

DI Lydia George said: “This is a deeply distressing incident. A family is grieving and our thoughts remain firmly with them at this incredibly difficult time.

“I would call on the public and media to please respect their privacy as we continue the early stages of this investigation. We are determined to get them answers and build as clear a picture as possible of the circumstances surrounding what has happened.”

George added that the police were not looking for any other suspects and that there was no ongoing risk to the public.

“This took place in a busy public area, and while we have already received valuable assistance from the public, we continue to appeal for information. Even the smallest detail could prove crucial.”
body.zh: 包括一名 14 岁男孩在内的三名青少年因涉嫌在埃塞克斯郡的一个公园谋杀一名 21 岁男子而被捕。 周五晚上 7 点左右，紧急服务人员赶到了切姆斯福德中央公园，发现受害者伤势严重。 埃塞克斯警方表示，尽管医护人员奋力抢救，这名 21 岁的男子仍当场死亡。调查立即开始，警方很快找到了切姆斯福德奥克兰克洛斯的一个地址。 警方发言人表示，三名年龄分别为 14 岁、17 岁和 18 岁的嫌疑人不久后被捕，目前仍被拘留接受审讯。 受害者的家人已收到通知，并正在接受经过专门培训的官员的支持。 DI Lydia George 表示：“这是一个令人深感悲痛的事件。一个家庭正在悲伤，在这个极其困难的时刻，我们的思念与他们同在。” “在我们继续调查的早期阶段时，我呼吁公众和媒体尊重他们的隐私。我们决心为他们提供答案，并尽可能清楚地了解所发生事件的情况。” 乔治补充说，警方没有在寻找任何其他嫌疑人，公众也不存在持续的风险。 “这件事发生在一个繁忙的公共区域，虽然我们已经得到了公众的宝贵帮助，但我们仍然呼吁提供信息。即使是最小的细节也可能至关重要。”

reflection.en: The tragic death of a young man, with teenagers arrested in connection, brings profound sorrow. In moments of such loss, we are reminded of the fragility of life and the deep pain that violence inflicts. Jesus himself wept at the tomb of a friend, showing us that grief is a natural and human response to death.
reflection.zh: 一名年轻男子不幸身亡，涉案青少年被捕，这带来了深切的悲痛。在这样的损失面前，我们被提醒生命的脆弱和暴力造成的深重痛苦。耶稣亲自在朋友的墓前哭泣，向我们表明悲伤是对死亡的自然和人性的回应。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Anthropic cuts top-tier AI access after US foreigner ban

summary.en: The firm said it was ordered to block foreign nationals from accessing its state of the art Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models on national security grounds.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The firm said it was ordered to block foreign nationals from accessing its state of the art Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models on national security grounds.

Anthropic said Friday it has cut access to two powerful artificial intelligence (AI) models after a United States  government order citing national security concerns.

The sudden block marks a major escalation in Anthropic’s growing showdown with the Trump administration after failed negotiations earlier this year over potential US military and intelligence use of its technology .

The order is potentially a major setback for Anthropic's plans to take the company public  later this year.

The San Francisco-headquartered firm said in a statement that it received a directive to block its Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 for all foreign nationals.

Fable 5 and Mythos 5 are the newest versions of the Claude AI model, released on June 9. The first is widely available to the public, while the latter is mostly restricted to vetted organizations.

The company said the ban applied to foreigners "whether inside or outside the United States, including foreign national Anthropic employees."

However, Anthropic said it had blocked access for all customers for now to ensure compliance.

"Our understanding is that the [US] government believes it has become aware of a method of bypassing, or 'jailbreaking' Fable," the statement continued.

It said the company's own tests found only a small number of already-known bugs that were "minor vulnerabilities."

Anthropic said it was complying with the directive, but disagreed that the US government's findings "should be cause for recalling a commercial model deployed to hundreds of millions of people."

It added that if this rule were applied across AI platforms, "we believe it would essentially halt all new model deployments for all frontier model providers."

Anthropic’s relationship with the US government broke down this year after the company refused to allow the military to use its AI models for domestic surveillance and fully autonomous weapons systems.

In response, the Pentagon added Anthropic to a supply chain blacklist , which is set to take effect later this year and could severely limit the company’s federal contracts.

This latest export ban marks the second major action by the Trump administration against the AI firm in just a few months.

The New York Times described the order as "unusually expansive," noting it could prevent Anthropic's employees in allied nations, including Canada or the United Kingdom, from using the AI models.

Earlier this month, US President Donald Trump signed an executive order requiring federal vetting of the most advanced AI systems for national security...
body.zh: 该公司表示，以国家安全为由，其被勒令禁止外国人访问其最先进的《神鬼寓言 5》和《神话 5》人工智能模型。 Anthropic 周五表示，在美国政府以国家安全为由发布命令后，该公司已切断对两种强大人工智能 (AI) 模型的访问。 今年早些时候，就美国军事和情报部门可能使用其技术的谈判失败后，这次突然的封锁标志着 Anthropic 与特朗普政府日益激烈的对峙大幅升级。 该命令可能对 Anthropic 公司今年晚些时候上市的计划造成重大挫折。 这家总部位于旧金山的公司在一份声明中表示，它收到了一项指令，要求对所有外国人屏蔽其《克劳德寓言 5》和《克劳德神话 5》。 《神鬼寓言 5》和《神话 5》是 Claude AI 模型的最新版本，于 6 月 9 日发布。第一个版本广泛向公众开放，而后者主要仅限于经过审查的组织。 该公司表示，该禁令适用于“无论是美国境内还是境外的外国人，包括 Anthropic 的外籍员工”。 不过，Anthropic 表示，为了确保合规性，目前已禁止所有客户访问。 “我们的理解是，[美国]政府认为它已经意识到一种绕过或‘越狱’Fable 的方法，”声明继续说道。 该公司表示，该公司自己的测试只发现了少数已知的“小漏洞”漏洞。 Anthropic 表示，它正在遵守该指令，但不同意美国政府的调查结果“应该成为召回部署到数亿人的商业模式的理由”。 它补充说，如果这条规则适用于人工智能平台，“我们相信它基本上会停止所有前沿模型提供商的所有新模型部署。” Anthropic 与美国政府的关系今年破裂，因为该公司拒绝允许军方将其人工智能模型用于国内监视和完全自主武器系统。 作为回应，五角大楼将 Anthropic 添加到供应链黑名单中，该名单将于今年晚些时候生效，可能会严重限制该公司的联邦合同。 这项最新的出口禁令标志着特朗普政府在短短几个月内针对这家人工智能公司采取的第二次重大行动。 《纽约时报》将这一命令描述为“异常广泛”，并指出它可能会阻止 Anthropic 在包括加拿大或英国在内的盟国的员工使用人工智能模型。 本月早些时候，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普签署了一项行政命令，要求联邦政府对最先进的人工智能系统进行国家安全审查……

title.en: US, Venezuela say Tren de Aragua leader killed in strike
title.zh: 美国和委内瑞拉称“阿拉瓜列车”帮派头目在袭击中丧生

summary.en: US President Donald Trump announced that the leader of the Venezuela-based Tren de Aragua gang, which Washington has designated a terrorist organization, was killed in a US strike.

body.en:
The leader of the Venezuela-based Tren de Aragua gang has died in a US strike, US President Donald Trump says. The gang has been labeled a terrorist organization by Washington.

The leader of the notorious Tren de Agua gang, Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, has been killed in a US strike in Venezuela , US President Donald Trump said on Friday.

The Trump administration has repeatedly accused Tren de Aragua of being behind much of the violence and drug dealing in many US cities.

Venezuela has confirmed the death of Guerrero Flores, saying he was killed during a "joint operation" with the US in the southeastern state of Bolivar.

Trump said the US had carried out a "swift and lethal kinetic" strike to kill Guerrero Flores, whom he called "the infamous leader” of the Tren de Aragua gang.

In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump wrote that "Tren de Aragua terrorists no longer have safe haven in Venezuela or anywhere else and, under my leadership, we will find these vicious murderers and drug lords anytime, anyplace, and send them to the depths of hell where they belong."

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth posted on X that the strike was carried out earlier in the week on one of the gang's compounds in Venezuela.

Rewards of up to $5 million (€4.32 million) had been offered by the US State Department for information that led to Guerrero Flores' arrest.

Venezuela's Ministry of Communications has confirmed the death in a statement about the operation at the compound. 

"There were clashes with members of these criminal structures, in which Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, alias 'Nino Guerrero,' was neutralized," it said.

Tren de Aragua came into being more than 10 years ago at a prison in Venezuela's central state of Aragua, where Guerrero Flores and other inmates took over control and administration as the country's economic crisis led to a neglect of jails.

Their power over the prison was such that they were able to turn the facility into a city-like structure with its own zoo, baseball field, casino and restaurants. 

The gang then expanded transnationally as  millions of Venezuelans emigrated in search of a better life.

Several countries, including Peru and Colombia, have accused the group of being behind rising violence in the region.

Guerrero Flores himself had racketeering, drug and firearms charges filed against him New York in December.

The Trump administration has also heavily targeted the gang, among other things with strikes in the eastern Pacific Ocean and Caribbean on small boats it says are smuggling drugs to the US.

title.en: Sudan war: UAE denies supporting RSF and Colombian recruits
title.zh: 苏丹战争：阿联酋否认支持快速支援部队和哥伦比亚雇佣兵

summary.en: Human rights organizations accuse the UAE of supporting the RSF militia, which has seen a number of high-profile defections to the Sudanese Armed Forces. Meanwhile, the civilian population continues to suffer.
summary.zh: 人权组织指控阿联酋支持快速支援部队民兵，该部队已有多名高级成员叛逃至苏丹武装部队。与此同时，苏丹平民仍在持续遭受苦难。

body.en:
Human rights organizations accuse the UAE of supporting the RSF militia, which has seen a number of high-profile defections to the Sudanese Armed Forces. Meanwhile, the civilian population continues to suffer.

When Sudan's military leader Abdel Fattah al-Burhan welcomed Al-Nour Ahmed Adam — also known as Al-Nour Al-Qubba and a former senior commander of the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) militia — into the ranks of the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) earlier this year, it was one of the most high-profile defections in the Sudanese civil war to date.

While the SAF controls the capital Khartoum, Port Sudan and large parts of the east and center of the country, its rival RSF holds vast areas in the west of the country, particularly in Darfur, including the city of El Fasher.

Al-Nour Al-Qubba is not the only defector: He was followed a few weeks later by high-ranking RSF commander, Ali Rizq Allah, also known as Al-Savannah.

Human Rights Watch (HRW) has reviewed videos purportedly showing these two defectors during the siege of El Fasher, where the international NGO has documented war crimes committed by the RSF , led by General Mohamed Hamdan Daglo, commonly known as Hemedti, during the city's capture in October 2025.

Since the war began in 2023 , Abdel Fattah al-Burhan has been trying to recruit defectors from the RSF into the SAF. Almost from the beginning, he declared a general amnesty for members of the militia if they laid down their arms, saying they could be integrated into the military. Human Rights Watch says it was unable to verify whether this also applied to the most recent defectors.

For Mohamed Osman, a Sudan researcher at Human Rights Watch, there must not be impunity. "Those responsible for serious international crimes and human rights violations do not get a free pass if they switch sides," he said, adding that "Sudanese people who have experienced horrific abuses under any commander's watch deserve justice."

According to conflict monitors at Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED), the recent defections could be a sign of increasing tension within the RSF ranks and of "cracks in the RSF's core alliances." They assume that "local loyalties are superseding central command, sparking violent intra-coalition competition over remaining war spoils."

The defections come at a time when both the SAF and the RSF have external support. Though the front is in Sudan, the alliances that are keeping the war going extend far beyond the country's borders. The RSF's supporters are believed to include the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Ethiopia , Libya , Chad and Kenya . The SAF, which has also been accused of war crimes, is supported by Egypt , Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Eritrea. Iran is also suspected of having provided military...
body.zh: 人权组织指责阿联酋支持 RSF 民兵，该民兵中有许多引人注目的叛逃者加入苏丹武装部队。与此同时，平民继续遭受苦难。 今年早些时候，苏丹军事领导人阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·布尔汉 (Abdel Fattah al-Burhan) 欢迎努尔·艾哈迈德·亚当 (Al-Nour Ahmed Adam)（又名 Al-Nour Al-Qubba，快速支援部队 (RSF) 民兵前高级指挥官）加入苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 队伍，这是迄今为止苏丹内战中最引人注目的叛逃事件之一。 虽然苏丹武装部队控制着首都喀土穆、苏丹港以及该国东部和中部的大部分地区，但其竞争对手无国界武装部队控制着该国西部的大片地区，特别是在达尔富尔，包括法希尔市。 努尔·库巴并不是唯一的叛逃者：几周后，无国界部队高级指挥官阿里·里兹克·阿拉（Ali Rizq Allah，也被称为阿尔·萨凡纳）也追随了他。 人权观察组织 (HRW) 审查了据称显示这两名叛逃者在法希尔围困期间的视频，该国际非政府组织记录了穆罕默德·哈姆丹·达格洛将军（俗称赫梅蒂）领导的无国界部队在 2025 年 10 月占领该市期间犯下的战争罪行。 自 2023 年战争爆发以来，阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·布尔汉一直试图招募无国界医生组织的叛逃者加入苏丹武装部队。几乎从一开始，他就宣布对放下武器的民兵成员实行大赦，并称他们可以编入军队。人权观察表示，无法核实这是否也适用于最近的叛逃者。 对于人权观察组织的苏丹研究员穆罕默德·奥斯曼来说，决不能有罪不罚。他说：“那些对严重国际罪行和侵犯人权行为负有责任的人，如果他们倒戈，就不会获得自由通行证。”他补充说，“在任何指挥官的监督下经历过可怕虐待的苏丹人民都应该受到正义的对待。” 根据武装冲突地点和事件数据项目 (ACLED) 的冲突监测员的说法，最近的叛逃可能是无国界医生组织内部紧张局势加剧以及“无国界医生组织核心联盟出现裂痕”的迹象。他们认为“地方忠诚正在取代中央指挥，引发了联盟内部对剩余战利品的激烈竞争。” 这些叛逃发生在新加坡武装部队和无国界部队都得到外部支持的情况下。尽管前线在苏丹，但维持战争持续的联盟却远远超出了该国的边界。据信，无国界医生组织的支持者包括阿拉伯联合酋长国（阿联酋）、埃塞俄比亚、利比亚、乍得和肯尼亚。苏丹武装部队也被指控犯有战争罪，得到埃及、沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和厄立特里亚的支持。伊朗还被怀疑提供了军事...

title.en: Swiss to vote on whether to cap population at 10 million
title.zh: 瑞士将投票决定是否将人口上限设为1000万

summary.en: Swiss voters will decide on June 14 whether to approve a far-right initiative to cap the country's population at 10 million, aiming to curb future immigration. The outcome could have significant economic implications for Switzerland and its European neighbors.

body.en:
On June 14, Swiss voters will be able to decide on a far-right initiative to curb future immigration. What will it mean for the economy — and the country's European neighbors — if they approve the proposal?

Swiss voters will soon have the chance to have their say in a referendum on the Civilian Service Act, asking whether the number of people moving from the army to civilian service should be reduced, as well as on a far-right initiative to cap the population at 10 million dubbed the "No to 10 million" initiative.

The question at the heart of the populist initiative, to be voted upon on June 14, is how many people should live in Switzerland . The far-right Swiss People's Party (SVP) , which proposed it, wants to ensure that the permanent population does not exceed 10 million after 2050.

The issue is not only about nationalism, psychology and xenophobia but also about economic interests.

From an economic perspective, this matter is far from simple, said Tobias Heidland from the Kiel Institute for the World Economy (IfW). He told DW that a "struggle would arise over what kind of immigration to still allow" if voters decided to limit immigration. He predicted that there would be widespread dissatisfaction in the business community, as well as in wider society, as "many highly qualified people would decide against migrating to Switzerland, which would probably be seen as "deterring the wrong ones.'"

Sabine Zinn from the Berlin-based German Institute for Economic Research (DIW) told DW that the question of whether immigration restrictions made sense could not be "answered with a simple yes or no." The real challenge, she said, lay in distinguishing between " migration of refugees on humanitarian grounds and labor migration based on economic necessity."

For Zinn, there are several economic reasons against imposing a general cap on immigration: "Many European countries, including Germany and Switzerland, face significant demographic challenges," she explained, pointing out that there were increasingly fewer people in the workforce who were responsible for funding social security systems. There was already a lack of qualified applications on the labor market, she added. "A blanket cap on immigration is likely to exacerbate these problems."

Wido Geis-Thöne, an expert on migration at the German Economic Institute (IW) in Cologne, pointed out that although the shortage of skilled workers would be a concern, the problem might lie more with "unskilled labor." He explained that many EU nationals worked in the hotel, restaurant and construction sectors and if they were no longer able to enter the country, this could cause problems. title.en: Why the Socceroos may have seen a dingo at their Californian World Cup training ground
title.zh: 本土联系和“矿物魔力”助力澳大利亚男足世界杯征程

summary.en: Australians are showing up in unlikely places to help with the Socceroos' preparation for the FIFA World Cup 2026.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚人正在意想不到的地方出现，帮助澳大利亚男足备战2026年国际足联世界杯。

body.en:
The Socceroos have been preparing at their California base for their first FIFA World Cup match, on a world-class pitch engineered by an Australian abroad.

The Australian side will take on Türkiye in Vancouver on Sunday afternoon Australian time.

They are now based at the Oakland Roots/Soul Training Facility, which is run by the football club of the same name.

The former home of the Oakland Raiders NFL team is also run by groundskeeper and facility manager Marc Logan, who speaks with a strong Australian accent.

Having lived in the US for 27 years, Logan said he was "ecstatic" when he learned that Australia's national football team would be based at the training ground he looks after.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Logan said he mixes a product called Mineral Magic — which comes from Western Australia — with the Californian soil under the immaculate pitches at the facility.

"It's an amorphous silica, and we've been using it for a number of years," Logan explained, adding that he hopes the product's Australian link will help power the Socceroos to strong World Cup performances.

Logan brought another reminder of home with him to California — a model of a dingo.

"I thought, 'what the heck?' I needed to have a dingo, just so I could say, has anybody seen my dingo?" he said.

"So it was important that I keep a little bit of Australia here. I've got a dingo here [to keep] the birds away."

The Roots are the club's men's team. They play in the US second professional tier. The Soul are the women's team, and play at amateur level.

In Alameda, where the club is based, the local community is known for its rich diversity.

Edreece Arghandiwal, co-founder of the Oakland Roots/Soul Club, told SBS News that football has had a "resounding effect" on his life.

He recalled that, when he arrived as a refugee aged five — along with his family and other members of the Afghan community — football "created a sense of identity and purpose in this community".

Arghandiwal said the small connections between the club and Australia through people like Logan were "once in a lifetime" stories.

"I think that all of this has aligned for some reason beyond us and I'm hopeful that that reason is Australia going very far in the tournament," he said.

"It's a benefit to us, it's a benefit to the entire nation, and we're really wishing them all here."

In another surprising twist, the club's left-back Jesus de Vincente used to live not far from Mat Ryan, Australia's veteran goalkeeper, and his mum works at Ryan's Spanish club, Levante.

De Vincente was born in the Spanish city of Valencia, which is also home to rival club Levante.

title.en: Married at First Sight Australia stars not told partners had drug and violence convictions
title.zh: 《一见钟情就结婚》澳大利亚版明星未被告知伴侣有毒品和暴力犯罪前科

summary.en: Stars of the hit TV show say they did not know their on-screen husbands had previous drug and violence convictions.
summary.zh: 热门电视节目的明星表示，他们不知道自己的荧幕丈夫曾有毒品和暴力犯罪前科。

body.en:
Married at First Sight Australia stars say the show left them feeling unsafe and unprotected because their on-screen partners had criminal pasts which they were not told about, a BBC investigation can reveal.

It comes after the British version of the show, known to many as MAFS UK, was plunged into crisis after BBC Panorama reported rape allegations from two women contestants - allegations the men involved have denied.

One woman from last year's Australian series says she was not told the man she had been matched with had a previous drug conviction and only found out after the show ended. "There should be informed consent," she told us.

We can also reveal that another groom from the same series had a past conviction for affray, which we understand his on-screen bride was not made aware of.

Nine former cast members from MAFS Australia have spoken to the BBC and are now calling on the show to improve its background checks and to stop allowing individuals with previous convictions or allegations on the show.

MAFS Australia is not made by the same production company as MAFS UK. Endemol Shine Australia is behind the show, which airs in Australia on Channel 9.

In a joint statement, Channel 9 and Endemol Shine Australia said they had "strong protocols in place to ensure participant safety and wellbeing".

As well as being a huge hit in Australia, the show is popular in the UK and is shown on Channel 4. The broadcaster has pulled all the UK episodes of MAFS from its streaming service All 4, but MAFS Australia remains available to watch.

Both programmes show single people agreeing to "marry" total strangers after meeting for the first time at their mock weddings.

The marriages are not legally binding, but viewers see the couples go on "honeymoons", before moving in together and navigating their relationships - all while being filmed, almost every day.

Several male contestants have been allowed on MAFS Australia despite having been convicted of, or having faced allegations of, violence, assault or drug use.

The BBC is reporting some of these details for the first time, while others have previously been reported in Australian media. We found many of the details in court records on a publicly accessible database.

Some female cast members we spoke to told us they had not been informed about their partners' criminal pasts when they were matched.

When we asked Channel 9 whether they had been - the broadcaster did not answer that specific question, but told us its protocols did not include sharing personal or background information between participants.

Sierah Swepstone, from last year's series, says she feels let down by the show's producers.

title.en: Australia is facing an El Niño. Experts say it won't be a 'super' event
title.zh: 澳大利亚面临厄尔尼诺现象，专家称其不会是“超级”事件

summary.en: Australia is preparing for an El Niño weather pattern, though experts predict it will not be a severe "super" event, contrasting with the triple La Niña experienced from 2020 to 2022.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚正准备迎接厄尔尼诺天气模式，但专家预测它不会是严重的“超级”事件，这与2020年至2022年经历的三重拉尼娜现象形成对比。

body.en:
As the weather changes, concerns are rising for a possible extreme El Niño.

However, weather experts aren't convinced that this year's El Niño event will be anything out of the ordinary.

El Niño and La Niña are part of a naturally occurring weather cycle, the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO).

The ENSO typically operates over one to eight years and alternates between periods of warming (El Niño) and cooling (La Niña) in the eastern and central tropical Pacific.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The tropical Pacific is the warm, equatorial region of the Pacific Ocean, which stretches along almost one-third of the Earth's surface, along the equator.

It's an area responsible for much global climate regulation and weather patterns.

Rising sea surface temperature in this region and weakened equatorial trade winds cause an El Niño.

For Australia, El Niño brings reduced rainfall, warmer temperatures, a shift in temperature extremes, increased frost risk, decreased alpine snow depths and increased fire danger in southeast regions.

Winds change ocean surface currents and pull cold water from the sea depths to the surface, lowering the sea surface temperature.

La Niña in Australia can mean increased rainfall, cooler daytime temperatures and warmer overnight temperatures, a shift in temperature extremes, decreased frost risk, increased tropical cyclone events and earlier monsoon onset.

On 2 June, the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) announced the formation of an El Niño.

Less than a week later, the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration predicted that there's a 63 per cent chance the El Niño event would become "very strong".

While some scientists define an El Niño as a temperature anomaly of 0.5 degrees Celsius above average, Australia's Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) defines an El Niño as 0.8 degrees Celsius above average.

For a super or extreme El Niño, sea surface temperature would be at least 2 to 2.5 degrees Celsius warmer than average.

A super El Niño can disrupt atmospheric circulation, leading to severe weather events such as thunderstorms and tropical cyclones in the eastern equatorial region.

For the western Pacific region, which includes Australia, super El Niños can cause devastating droughts and wildfires — including the Ash Wednesday bushfires of February 1983.

Super El Niños can cause an increased decline in marine life, and massive global economic loss.

The chances of a super El Niño in 2026 are slim, particularly because it follows a triple La Niña between late 2020 and mid-2022.

title.en: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in airstrike, Trump says
title.zh: 美国总统称，美军空袭击毙委内瑞拉“阿拉瓜列车”帮派头目

summary.en: The US President announced that Niño Guerrero, leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang, was killed in an American airstrike.
summary.zh: 美国总统宣布，委内瑞拉“阿拉瓜列车”帮派头目尼诺·格雷罗在美国的一次空袭中被击毙。

body.en:
The US military has killed the leader of the Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua in an airstrike, President Donald Trump has announced.

"At my direction, the United States Southern Command delivered a swift and lethal kinetic strike to successfully execute Niño Guerrero," Trump wrote on social media.

Niño Guerrero, whose full name is Héctor Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, was the longtime leader of Tren de Aragua. The gang is one of the most notorious criminal groups in Latin America and has been a target of the Trump administration.

The president has accused the group of engaging in "irregular warfare" against the US and declared it a foreign terrorist organisation.

Trump posted footage of what appears to be the airstrike, showing a green building with a nearby shed being blown up, debris flying into the air. Trump said the military action was "coordinated closely with our friends in Venezuela, with whom we are working very well".

Venezuelan authorities confirmed their involvement in what they described as a "joint operation".

In January, American forces seized then-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro from his compound in a dramatic overnight raid to face criminal charges in New York. The US accused him of collaborating with the gang. The indictment named Guerrero Flores as a co-conspirator.

Since then, the US has sought to tighten ties with Maduro's successor, Delcy Rodríguez, lifting sanctions on her and pushing to collaborate on the extraction of Venezuela's oil reserves - the most plentiful on earth.

Under Guerrero's leadership, Tren de Aragua expanded into Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Chile and diversified from extorting migrants into sex-trafficking, contract killing and kidnapping.

It was originally a prison gang that Niño Guerrero turned into a "transnational criminal organisation", according to the US state department, which had offered millions for information leading to his arrest.

Guerrero spent years in and out of prison. In 2012, he escaped by bribing a guard and was then rearrested in 2013.

Upon his return, he transformed the Tocorón Prison in the northern Venezuelan state of Aragua into a leisure complex, complete with zoo, restaurants, nightclub, betting shop and swimming pool.

In September 2023, Maduro - then still president - sent 11,000 soldiers to storm and wrestle back control of the jail. Guerrero escaped - again.

In and out of prison, he was still able to expand the gang's influence, seizing control of gold mines in Bolivar state, drug corridors on the Caribbean coast, and clandestine border crossings between Venezuela and Colombia, according to the US state department.

By most accounts, Tren de Aragua spread out of Venezuela when the country entered a humanitarian and economic emergency in 2014 that made crime less...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布，美国军方在一次空袭中击毙了委内瑞拉黑帮特伦·德·阿拉瓜的头目。 特朗普在社交媒体上写道：“在我的指示下，美国南方司令部发动了迅速而致命的动能打击，成功处决了尼诺·格雷罗。” 尼诺·格雷罗（Niño Guerrero），全名赫克托·鲁斯滕福德·格雷罗·弗洛雷斯（Héctor Rusthenford Guerrero Flores），是特伦·德·阿拉瓜的长期领导人。该团伙是拉丁美洲最臭名昭著的犯罪集团之一，一直是特朗普政府的打击目标。 总统指责该组织从事针对美国的“非常规战争”，并宣布其为外国恐怖组织。 特朗普发布了似乎是空袭的视频，显示一栋绿色建筑和附近的棚屋被炸毁，碎片飞向空中。特朗普表示，军事行动是“与我们在委内瑞拉的朋友密切协调的，我们与他们合作得很好”。 委内瑞拉当局证实他们参与了他们所说的“联合行动”。 一月份，美国军队在一次戏剧性的连夜突袭中，从时任委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的官邸中将其抓获，并在纽约面临刑事指控。美国指责他与该团伙合作。起诉书将格雷罗·弗洛雷斯列为同谋。 此后，美国寻求加强与马杜罗的继任者德尔西·罗德里格斯的关系，取消对她的制裁，并推动合作开采委内瑞拉的石油储备——地球上最丰富的石油储备。 在格雷罗的领导下，特伦·德阿拉瓜的业务扩展到哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔、秘鲁和智利，业务范围从勒索移民转向性贩运、雇佣杀人和绑架。 据美国国务院称，尼诺·格雷罗最初是一个监狱团伙，后来变成了一个“跨国犯罪组织”，并为导致他被捕提供了数百万美元的信息。 格雷罗在监狱内外度过了数年。 2012年，他通过贿赂一名警卫而越狱，并于2013年再次被捕。 回国后，他将委内瑞拉北部阿拉瓜州的托科隆监狱改造成一个休闲综合体，配有动物园、餐厅、夜总会、博彩店和游泳池。 2023 年 9 月，时任总统的马杜罗派出 11,000 名士兵冲锋并夺回监狱的控制权。格雷罗再次逃脱。 据美国国务院称，在监狱内外，他仍然能够扩大该团伙的影响力，控制玻利瓦尔州的金矿、加勒比海岸的毒品走廊以及委内瑞拉和哥伦比亚之间的秘密过境点。 大多数人认为，当委内瑞拉在 2014 年进入人道主义和经济紧急状态、犯罪减少时，Tren de Aragua 就从委内瑞拉蔓延开来……

reflection.en: This news reports a decisive action taken to neutralize a criminal leader. Romans 12:21 reminds us to not be overcome by evil, but to overcome evil with good. It prompts us to consider the nature of the "good" we employ when confronting profound evil, and whether our methods truly lead to lasting peace.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻报道了一项旨在铲除犯罪头目的果断行动。《罗马书》12:21提醒我们，不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。这促使我们思考在面对深重邪恶时，我们所使用的“善”的本质，以及我们的方法是否真正能带来持久的和平。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: US and Iran say deal closer than ever, as enriched uranium disagreements continue
title.zh: 美国和伊朗称协议比以往任何时候都更接近，但浓缩铀分歧仍在继续

summary.en: Iranian officials have stated that an agreement with the United States on most points of a potential deal is closer than ever, despite ongoing disagreements regarding enriched uranium.
summary.zh: 伊朗官员表示，尽管在浓缩铀问题上仍存在分歧，但与美国就一项潜在协议的大部分要点已达成一致，比以往任何时候都更接近。

body.en:
Iranian and United States officials said Saturday a deal to end the Middle East war was closer than ever, with mediator Pakistan also expressing optimism that an elusive agreement was within reach.

But during weeks of halting negotiations — marked by threats and exchanges of fire despite an April truce — US President Donald Trump has repeatedly insisted that a deal was all but signed, only for talks to drag on .

And disagreements between the two sides persisted, with Iranian state media publishing a breakdown of what was purportedly on the table that was at odds with the US' account.

"The Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding has never been closer," Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi wrote in a social media post, referring to the Pakistani capital that hosted previous US-Iran talks.

Trump — who early on Saturday accused the Iranians of negotiating in bad faith and misrepresenting the terms that had been agreed — posted a screenshot of Araghchi message on his own feed just hours later.

Araghchi provided some details on the agreement in an interview with state television, saying it calls for the lifting of the US naval blockade of Iran's ports and unspecified changes to the administration of the Strait of Hormuz, a key maritime trade route for oil and gas from the Gulf.

He also said the only way to deal with the country's enriched uranium — which the US alleges is part of a nuclear weapons program — "is to dilute it inside Iran".

Disputing Trump's "bad faith" accusation, Iranian foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei said an agreement had now been reached with the US "on most points".

Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, whose country has been a key mediator since the initial talks , confirmed that "a final, agreed-upon text of the peace deal has been reached".

"Peace has never been as close as it is now," Sharif said, while acknowledging "incessant misinformation" surrounding the deal.

A senior US official also voiced optimism that the parties would be "signing this agreement over the next few days".

"If I were to give you a confidence that we were going to be signing this agreement, I maybe would have said 75 per cent this morning; it's probably more like 80-85 per cent now, but it's not 100 per cent," the official told reporters in a call.

body.en:
Shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX closed almost 20 per cent higher on their trading debut Friday after the biggest IPO in history, making the polarising entrepreneur the world's first trillionaire as he vowed to take humanity to Mars.

The initial public offering, which raised more than US$75 billion ($106 billion), is expected to kick off a series of major IPOs by AI companies in the coming months.

The debut on the Nasdaq exchange in New York capped weeks of investor frenzy over the rocket company turned AI and satellite conglomerate.

The stock climbed as high as US$176 ($250), or 31 per cent above its offering price of US$135 ($191), in its first session before ending the day at US$161.50 ($229).

"SpaceX wants to be able to take you to the Moon, take you to Mars, and ultimately beyond," Musk said at a launch event in Starbase, Texas, surrounded by staff, many of whom became multi-millionaires with the launch of trading.

"I'm confident at this point that with the incredible team that we have here at SpaceX, that we will do that for you," Musk added.

About 100 people assembled outside the Nasdaq's home in New York, where SpaceX also marked the occasion with a neon sign in Times Square.

Musk "sets very futuristic goals that no one else is doing, and I think that has got a lot of people excited," said Sarin Sio, of financial company Dovetail, who had come to the Nasdaq headquarters.

The company priced more than 555 million shares at US$135 ($191) each in a Thursday filing with the US markets regulator, valuing SpaceX at just under US$1.8 trillion ($2.5 trillion).

Friday's gain lifted SpaceX's market value to more than US$2 trillion ($2.8 trilion), placing it among the 10 most valuable American companies — ahead of Tesla, Facebook-owner Meta and Walmart.

Options for nearly 83 million additional shares could push the total raised above US$86 billion ($122 billion).

Co-founded by Musk in 2002, the rocket startup has since expanded into a major satellite operator and has also folded in Musk's artificial intelligence company — xAI — which includes the social media platform X.

Trading under the ticker symbol "SPCX," the conglomerate is being closely watched for how Wall Street absorbs the offering and what it will mean for its AI rivals looking to trade on the public markets as early as this year.

Friday's IPO comes just over a year after Musk left President Donald Trump's administration, following a months-long stint leading the highly contentious "DOGE" effort to slash government spending — while simultaneously juggling his CEO roles at Tesla and SpaceX.

title.en: Why India wants German submarines – and what Pakistan and China have to do with it

summary.en: A multibillion-dollar submarine deal between India and Germany reflects New Delhi’s push for military self-reliance — and Berlin’s growing interest in the Indo-Pacific.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A multibillion-dollar submarine deal between India and Germany reflects New Delhi’s push for military self-reliance — and Berlin’s growing interest in the Indo-Pacific.

India  is moving to strengthen its navy with a new generation of submarines designed in Germany and to be built in India. The deal, worth around $8 billion (€7 billion), is expected to be signed this summer, according to the German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius .

The deal comes as the Indo‑Pacific turns into an increasingly contested arena , with submarines playing a central role. China's growing naval reach and Pakistan's deepening military ties with Beijing are sharpening India's sense of urgency.

The submarines in question are German-designed Type 214 boats, built by Thyssenkrupp Marine Systems, or TKMS. They are diesel-electric submarines, not nuclear-powered ones. But they include key technology that makes them especially valuable: air-independent propulsion (AIP).

That technology allows them to stay underwater much longer than other conventional submarines — making them harder to detect and better suited for patrols in crowded waters.

India has more than 11,000 kilometers (about 6,840 miles) of coastline, and more than 90% of its trade by volume moves by sea. But the Indian Ocean also contains several chokepoints  — narrow passages where sea traffic can be disrupted. Any threat to these routes can quickly become a threat to India's economy. 

"This is why it's so important for India to maintain freedom of navigation in the Indo-Pacific region", said Shairee Malhotra, Deputy Director of the Strategic Studies Program at the Observer Research Foundation (ORF) in New Delhi. "Which is why India wants to enhance its naval power. And these submarines would mark a major advancement in India's undersea warfare capabilities."

Submarines are useful in this environment because they can patrol quietly, monitor enemy ships, and create uncertainty for stronger surface fleets. In a crisis, they can act as a deterrent.

"Submarines are evolving into one of the most crucial capabilities in terms of maritime power in the Indo-Pacific," said Sidharth Kaushal, Senior Research Fellow for sea power at the Royal United Services Institute in London. One reason, he said, is that "the surface there is increasingly becoming a very heavily contested and even denied space."

Traditional diesel-electric submarines must regularly surface to take in air for their engines. That makes them more visible and more vulnerable. AIP changes this. "What AIP allows a submarine to do is remain submerged for longer periods without a requirement to snorkel like traditional conventional submarines," Kaushal said.

body.en: Ministry says animals fitted with sensors by foreign agencies collect sensitive sea data, in ‘invisible secret war’ China’s ministry of state security has claimed that foreign espionage and intelligence agencies are using innovative new methods to monitor the country’s waters, including deploying “spy” animals fitted with sensors. In a post on the Chinese platform WeChat on Friday, the ministry warned that an “invisible secret war” was quietly playing out in the seas around China as foreign agencies were collecting sensitive data “through a variety of new spying devices” to produce underwater maps that pose a “serious threat to our national security”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 外交部表示，外国机构安装传感器的动物在“看不见的秘密战争”中收集敏感的海洋数据 中国国家安全部声称，外国间谍和情报机构正在使用创新的新方法来监视该国水域，包括部署安装有传感器的“间谍”动物。周五，中国国防部在中国微信平台上发帖警告称，一场“看不见的秘密战争”正在中国周边海域悄然上演，外国机构“通过各种新型间谍设备”收集敏感数据，以制作水下地图，“对我们的国家安全构成严重威胁”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report of an "invisible secret war" reminds us that conflicts often run deeper than what is immediately visible. The Apostle Paul reminds us that our struggles are not merely against human adversaries, but against unseen forces that can fuel suspicion and division. In such times, it is wise to remember the spiritual dimensions at play, seeking...
reflection.zh: 这份关于“无形秘密战争”的报道提醒我们，冲突往往比表面上看到的更深层。使徒保罗提醒我们，我们的争战并非仅与人对抗，而是与那些可能助长猜疑和分裂的看不见的力量对抗。在这样的时刻，明智的做法是记住其中存在的属灵层面，寻求超越表面指控的洞察力。

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verse.textZh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

title.en: China has long sought to control women’s bodies. Increasingly, they’re making their own choices
title.zh: 中国长期寻求控制女性身体，但她们正日益做出自己的选择

summary.en: Chinese women are increasingly asserting their reproductive choices, pushing back against decades of state control, including the lasting impact of the one-child policy. Since 1949, the state has historically dictated women's bodies and labor.
summary.zh: 面对国家长期以来的压力以及独生子女政策的深远影响，越来越多的中国女性正在自主做出她们的生育选择。自1949年中华人民共和国成立以来，女性的身体一直被视为国家事务。

body.en: More women are rejecting state pressure over their reproductive choices, amid the devastating legacy of the one-child policy Ever since the founding of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, women’s bodies have been the business of the state. In the 1950s, labour for state-controlled work units was organised according to women’s menstrual cycles. Then for decades, there was the one-child policy. Across vast swathes of the country the policy was enforced with a brutal severity. As well as fines for additional children, women were forced to have abortions and subjected to forced sterilisations. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在独生子女政策造成的毁灭性影响中，越来越多的女性拒绝接受国家对她们生育选择的压力。自 1949 年中华人民共和国成立以来，女性的身体一直是国家的事。 20世纪50年代，国家控制的单位的劳动是根据妇女的月经周期来组织的。然后几十年来，一胎政策一直存在。在全国大片地区，这项政策得到了残酷的严厉执行。除了对额外孩子处以罚款外，妇女还被迫堕胎和强制绝育。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights a profound human desire for autonomy over one's own body, especially in deeply personal matters like reproduction. This resonates with the biblical truth that our bodies are not our own, but temples of the Holy Spirit, entrusted to us by God. It reminds us that ultimate authority over our lives and bodies rests with our Creator, not with...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了人们对身体自主权的深切渴望，尤其是在生育等极其私人的事务上。这与圣经的真理不谋而合，即我们的身体不属于自己，而是圣灵的殿，是神托付给我们的。它提醒我们，对我们生命和身体的最终主权在于我们的创造主，而非任何世俗权力。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that your bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own.
verse.textZh: 岂不知你们的身子就是圣灵的殿吗？这圣灵是从神而来，住在你们里面的。并且你们不是自己的人。

title.en: Thai court sentences two Uyghur men to death for 2015 Bangkok bombing
title.zh: 泰国法院判处两名维吾尔族男子死刑，罪名是2015年曼谷爆炸案

summary.en: A Thai court has sentenced two Uyghur men to death for their involvement in the 2015 Bangkok bombing at the Erawan Shrine, which killed 20 people and injured 120.
summary.zh: 泰国法院判处两名维吾尔族男子死刑，罪名是他们参与了2015年曼谷四面佛神庙爆炸案，该案造成20人死亡，120人受伤。

body.en: Twenty people were killed and 120 injured in the attack at the Erawan Shrine, a popular tourist destination A Thai court has handed out death sentences to two Uyghur men from the north-western Chinese region of Xinjiang for a 2015 bombing in the centre of Bangkok that killed 20 people. The explosion occurred at the Erawan Shrine in the centre of Bangkok, an area popular with foreign tourists. As well as the 20 people killed, another 120 were injured. Five of the dead were from mainland China and two from Hong Kong. Continue reading...
body.zh: 热门旅游胜地四面佛发生袭击事件，造成 20 人死亡、120 人受伤。泰国法院对两名来自中国西北部新疆地区的维吾尔男子判处死刑，他们因 2015 年曼谷市中心发生的爆炸事件造成 20 人死亡。爆炸发生在曼谷市中心的四面佛，这里是外国游客喜爱的地区。除20人死亡外，另有120人受伤。死者中有五名来自中国大陆，两名来自香港。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic sentencing of these men for the horrific Bangkok bombing underscores the devastating consequences of violence. Jesus' words remind us that those who initiate violence often face severe repercussions, highlighting the destructive cycle that harms all involved. This solemn outcome serves as a stark reminder of the ultimate cost of resorting to such...
reflection.zh: 这些男子因曼谷爆炸案被判处死刑的悲剧性判决，凸显了暴力的毁灭性后果。雅伟的话语提醒我们，那些诉诸暴力的人常常面临严重的报应，这突显了伤害所有参与者的破坏性循环。这一庄严的结局，是对诉诸此类行为最终代价的严峻警示。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: China’s Jingye seeks compensation from UK over British Steel takeover
title.zh: 中国敬业集团就收购英国钢铁公司一事向英国寻求赔偿

summary.en: China's Jingye Group is seeking over £1 billion in compensation from the UK government, initiating a formal process under an international treaty. This dispute, stemming from its takeover of British Steel, could strain relations between the two countries.
summary.zh: 中国敬业集团已根据一项国际条约启动正式程序，向英国政府索赔超过10亿英镑。这起源于其收购英国钢铁公司的纠纷，可能会给两国关系带来压力。

body.en: Sources say firm is asking for more than £1bn in row that could put pressure on two countries’ relationship Business live – latest updates The Chinese owner of British Steel has started a formal process under an international treaty to win compensation from the UK government over its decision to nationalise the Scunthorpe steelworks. Jingye Steel said it would seek to recover money via China’s bilateral investment treaty with the UK, after more than a year of negotiations over the size of any payout. The dispute could put pressure on the relationship between China and the UK. Continue reading...
body.zh: 消息人士称，该公司连续索要超过 10 亿英镑，这可能会给两国关系带来压力。 英国钢铁公司的中国所有者已根据一项国际条约启动正式程序，争取英国政府就其将斯肯索普钢铁厂国有化的决定做出赔偿。敬业钢铁表示，在就支付金额进行了一年多的谈判后，将寻求通过中国与英国的双边投资条约收回资金。这场争端可能会给中英关系带来压力。继续阅读...

reflection.en: International disputes, even those rooted in business, can test the fabric of diplomatic relations. In such moments, the call to pursue peace, as far as it depends on us, becomes a guiding principle for all parties involved. Seeking fair resolution while striving to maintain respectful relationships is a challenging but vital endeavor.
reflection.zh: 国际争端，即使是源于商业的争端，也会考验外交关系的韧性。在这样的时刻，尽力与众人和睦相处，成为所有相关方的指导原则。在寻求公平解决方案的同时，努力维护相互尊重的关系，是一项充满挑战但至关重要的工作。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: China’s BYD aims to be world’s biggest car firm within five years
title.zh: 中国比亚迪目标五年内成为全球最大汽车公司

summary.en: Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer BYD has announced its ambitious goal to become the world's largest car firm within the next five years, aiming to surpass Toyota. The company plans a significant investment of £1.8bn to develop five-minute flash chargers in Europe as part of its expansion strategy.
summary.zh: 中国电动汽车制造商比亚迪宣布其宏伟目标，即在未来五年内超越丰田，成为全球最大的汽车公司。作为其扩张战略的一部分，该公司计划投资18亿英镑在欧洲开发五分钟闪充充电器。

body.en: EV maker aims to overtake Toyota, as it plans to spend £1.8bn to build five-minute flash chargers in Europe Business live – latest updates The Chinese car company BYD has said it aims to be the world’s biggest automaker within the next five years. Targeting Toyota’s long-held top spot, BYD’s founder and chair, Wang Chuanfu said he was confident it could overtake global rivals through rapid advances in battery technology and fast charging, as well as growing production overseas, including Europe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 电动汽车制造商的目标是超越丰田，计划斥资 18 亿英镑在欧洲生产五分钟闪存充电器 商业直播 - 最新动态 中国汽车公司比亚迪表示，其目标是在未来五年内成为全球最大的汽车制造商。针对丰田长期占据的领先地位，比亚迪创始人兼董事长王传福表示，他有信心通过电池技术和快速充电技术的快速进步，以及包括欧洲在内的海外生产的增长，比亚迪能够超越全球竞争对手。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of ambitious goals, like becoming a global industry leader, requires immense planning, effort, and strategic investment. For those who seek to honor God in their endeavors, Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our work to 雅伟, trusting that He will establish our plans. This perspective encourages diligence while acknowledging a higher source of...
reflection.zh: 追求宏伟目标，例如成为全球行业领导者，需要巨大的规划、努力和战略投资。对于那些在事业中寻求荣耀神的人来说，箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们所做的一切交托给雅伟，相信他会使我们的计划得以实现。这种观点鼓励勤奋，同时也承认智慧和成功的更高源泉。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Chinese activist in UK told by X that abusive deepfakes do not breach rules
title.zh: 中国活动家在英国被告知，X平台认为其遭受的深度伪造辱骂不违反规定

summary.en: A high-profile Chinese activist in the UK, Apple Peiqing Ni, was targeted by deepfake posts on X (formerly Twitter) that falsely portrayed her as a promiscuous drug addict after she posted about Tiananmen Square. X reportedly informed her that these abusive deepfakes did not breach its rules.
summary.zh: 英国知名中国活动家倪培清在X平台（前身为推特）发布关于天安门广场的内容后，遭到深度伪造帖子攻击，这些帖子虚假地将其描绘成一个滥交的吸毒者。据报道，X平台告知她，这些辱骂性的深度伪造内容并未违反其规定。

body.en: Apple Peiqing Ni targeted by account portraying her as promiscuous drug addict after posting about Tiananmen Square A high-profile Chinese activist in the UK who was inundated with deepfake posts on X portraying her as a sexually promiscuous drug addict was told that the abuse did not breach the rules of Elon Musk’s platform. Apple Peiqing Ni, the 27-year-old founder of the UK-based China Dissent Network, had been advised by UK police to complain to the US-headquartered platform after she was targeted by what she believes is a pro-regime bot. Continue reading...
body.zh: 苹果公司倪培清在发布有关天安门广场的帖子后，遭到将她描述为性乱的吸毒者的账户的攻击。一位在英国的知名中国活动人士在 X 上被大量将她描绘成性乱交的吸毒者的 Deepfake 帖子淹没，但她被告知，这种虐待行为并没有违反埃隆·马斯克平台的规则。总部位于英国的中国异议网络 (China Dissent Network) 27 岁创始人苹果公司 (Apple) 倪培清 (Peiqing Ni) 在成为她认为亲政权机器人的攻击目标后，英国警方建议她向这家总部位于美国的平台投诉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age where digital tools can easily fabricate and spread falsehoods, the integrity of truth-telling becomes ever more crucial. This incident highlights the pain caused when platforms fail to uphold standards against deliberate misinformation, leaving individuals vulnerable to malicious attacks. As believers, we are called to put away falsehood and...
reflection.zh: 在数字工具可以轻易伪造和传播谎言的时代，诚实地讲述真相变得尤为重要。这起事件凸显了当平台未能坚持打击蓄意虚假信息的标准时所造成的伤害，使个人容易受到恶意攻击。作为信徒，我们蒙召要弃绝谎言，对邻舍说实话，因为我们是互为肢体的。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: 'Important consensus': What we know about Xi Jinping's North Korean visit
title.zh: “重要共识”：我们对习近平访问朝鲜的了解

summary.en: The Chinese President has made his first visit to North Korea since 2019, marking an important diplomatic engagement between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国国家主席自2019年以来首次访问朝鲜，标志着两国之间一次重要的外交接触。

body.en:
Chinese President Xi Jinping has visited North Korea for a series of meetings with leader Kim Jong Un.

The pair reached an "important consensus" on the nation's ties in a "new era", according to Xi.

Xi arrived in the North Korean capital Pyongyang on Monday for his first official visit to the diplomatically isolated nation since 2019.

He travelled with his wife and several other top officials for a two-day trip, he said, aimed to bring ties between the longtime partners to "new heights".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The visit follows Xi's hosting of a string of world leaders, including US President Donald Trump and Russia's Vladimir Putin, in Beijing.

State media images showed Xi and Kim beaming as they shook hands, with the Chinese leader receiving a lavish welcome ceremony featuring a red-carpet military salute and cheering crowds.

Xi said he had reached "an important consensus with Kim on developing China-DPRK relations in the new era", China's Xinhua news agency reported, using North Korea's official acronym.

The leaders agreed to put the two nations' friendly relations "on a more solid basis", North Korea's official Korean Central News Agency said.

Chinese state media reported Xi told Kim their countries "should strengthen exchanges in diplomacy, law enforcement [and] the military" and expand economic cooperation.

He also called for expanded economic cooperation, citing the recent reopening of border crossings and transport links.

China has long been North Korea's largest economic partner, with US and South Korean estimates indicating that China has accounted for almost all of North Korea's annual foreign trade in recent years.

In March, flights and passenger train services between the two nations resumed after a six-year hiatus due to pandemic-era border closures and their aftermath.

Official readouts and state media reports have not said whether Xi and Kim discussed North Korea's nuclear weapons development, for which the nation languishes under international sanctions.

Last month, the White House announced that the Chinese leader and Trump had "confirmed their shared goal to denuclearise North Korea" during their summit in Beijing.

Kim has repeatedly vowed never to give up his nuclear arsenal, and his sister said before Xi's visit that the program was North Korea's "line of no retreat".

The absence of denuclearisation from official statements means the summit effectively "appeared to have been a forum where China granted Pyongyang's rights to nuclear weapons", Lee Ho-ryung of the Korea Institute for Defence Analyses told AFP.

In return, it appears Kim supported China's "One-China principle regarding Taiwan", she added,...
body.zh: 中国国家主席习近平访问朝鲜并与领导人金正恩进行了一系列会晤。 习近平表示，两国元首就“新时代”两国关系达成“重要共识”。 习近平周一抵达朝鲜首都平壤，这是他自 2019 年以来首次对这个外交孤立国家进行正式访问。 他说，他与妻子和其他几位高级官员一起进行了为期两天的旅行，旨在将这两个长期合作伙伴之间的关系提升到“新的高度”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 此次访问之前，习近平在北京接待了包括美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在内的一系列世界领导人。 官方媒体画面显示，习近平和金正恩握手时笑容满面，中国领导人接受了盛大的欢迎仪式，包括红地毯军礼和欢呼的人群。 据中国新华社报道，习近平表示，他“同金正恩就发展新时代中朝关系达成重要共识”。 朝鲜官方通讯社朝中社称，两国领导人同意将两国友好关系建立在“更坚实的基础上”。 中国官方媒体报道称，习近平告诉金正恩，两国“应加强外交、执法[和]军事方面的交流”并扩大经济合作。 他还呼吁扩大经济合作，并列举了最近重新开放的过境点和运输线路。 中国长期以来一直是朝鲜最大的经济伙伴，美国和韩国的估计表明，中国近年来几乎占据了朝鲜年度对外贸易的全部。 今年三月，两国之间的航班和客运列车服务在因大流行时期边境关闭及其后果而中断六年后恢复。 官方消息和官方媒体报道均未提及习近平和金正恩是否讨论了朝鲜的核武器开发问题，该国因核武器开发而受到国际制裁。 上个月，白宫宣布中国领导人和特朗普在北京峰会期间“确认了朝鲜无核化的共同目标”。 金正恩一再发誓永远不会放弃他的核武库，他的妹妹在习近平访问之前表示，该计划是朝鲜的“不退路”。 韩国国防分析研究所的李浩良告诉法新社，官方声明中没有无核化，这意味着这次峰会实际上“似乎是中国授予平壤核武器权利的论坛”。 她补充说，作为回报，金正恩似乎支持中国的“一个中国原则”。

reflection.en: High-level diplomatic visits like this one underscore the complex decisions leaders face in international relations. Proverbs reminds us that nations find stability and safety when guided by wise counsel. In a world of intricate alliances and challenges, seeking broad wisdom is crucial for navigating geopolitical landscapes.
reflection.zh: 像这样的高层外交访问，突显了领导人在国际关系中面临的复杂决策。箴言提醒我们，国家在有明智的指导时才能找到稳定和安全。在一个联盟错综复杂、挑战重重的世界里，寻求广博的智慧对于驾驭地缘政治格局至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

summary.en: Protesters and supporters of Pauline Hanson clashed outside a fundraiser, leading to police intervention. The event's location was reportedly changed due to anticipated protests, though Hanson cited 'too many bookings'.
summary.zh: 在一次筹款活动外，抗议者与宝琳·汉森的支持者发生冲突，导致警方介入。据报道，该活动的地点因预期中的抗议而更改，尽管汉森声称是由于“预订过多”。

body.en: Pauline Hanson claimed fundraiser was moved from original location due to ‘too many bookings’, not because of expected protests Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Protesters have clashed with Pauline Hanson supporters, with one man given a move on notice outside a Melbourne venue hosting a One Nation fundraiser on Friday. title.en: Australia is facing an El Niño. Experts say it won't be a 'super' event
title.zh: 澳大利亚面临厄尔尼诺现象，专家称其不会是“超级”事件

summary.en: Australia is preparing for an El Niño weather pattern, though experts predict it will not be a severe "super" event, contrasting with the triple La Niña experienced from 2020 to 2022.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚正准备迎接厄尔尼诺天气模式，但专家预测它不会是严重的“超级”事件，这与2020年至2022年经历的三重拉尼娜现象形成对比。

body.en:
As the weather changes, concerns are rising for a possible extreme El Niño.

However, weather experts aren't convinced that this year's El Niño event will be anything out of the ordinary.

El Niño and La Niña are part of a naturally occurring weather cycle, the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO).

The ENSO typically operates over one to eight years and alternates between periods of warming (El Niño) and cooling (La Niña) in the eastern and central tropical Pacific.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The tropical Pacific is the warm, equatorial region of the Pacific Ocean, which stretches along almost one-third of the Earth's surface, along the equator.

It's an area responsible for much global climate regulation and weather patterns.

Rising sea surface temperature in this region and weakened equatorial trade winds cause an El Niño.

For Australia, El Niño brings reduced rainfall, warmer temperatures, a shift in temperature extremes, increased frost risk, decreased alpine snow depths and increased fire danger in southeast regions.

Winds change ocean surface currents and pull cold water from the sea depths to the surface, lowering the sea surface temperature.

La Niña in Australia can mean increased rainfall, cooler daytime temperatures and warmer overnight temperatures, a shift in temperature extremes, decreased frost risk, increased tropical cyclone events and earlier monsoon onset.

On 2 June, the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) announced the formation of an El Niño.

Less than a week later, the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration predicted that there's a 63 per cent chance the El Niño event would become "very strong".

While some scientists define an El Niño as a temperature anomaly of 0.5 degrees Celsius above average, Australia's Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) defines an El Niño as 0.8 degrees Celsius above average.

For a super or extreme El Niño, sea surface temperature would be at least 2 to 2.5 degrees Celsius warmer than average.

A super El Niño can disrupt atmospheric circulation, leading to severe weather events such as thunderstorms and tropical cyclones in the eastern equatorial region.

For the western Pacific region, which includes Australia, super El Niños can cause devastating droughts and wildfires — including the Ash Wednesday bushfires of February 1983.

Super El Niños can cause an increased decline in marine life, and massive global economic loss.

The chances of a super El Niño in 2026 are slim, particularly because it follows a triple La Niña between late 2020 and mid-2022.

title.en: Woman fighting for her life after shark attack at popular Sydney beach

summary.en: A woman is in critical condition, fighting for her life, after being attacked by a shark at a popular Sydney beach. She was airlifted to a hospital for urgent treatment for severe injuries to her limbs.

body.en:
A woman is fighting for life after being mauled by a shark at one of Australia's busiest beaches.

The incident follows a recent spate of fatal attacks nationwide and has prompted calls for stronger shark mitigation strategies across NSW.

Emergency services were called to Coogee Beach in Sydney's eastern suburbs shortly after 11am on Saturday following reports a swimmer had been bitten by a shark.

Bystanders pulled her from the water and commenced first aid before emergency services arrived.

Police rendered first aid to the woman, believed to be aged in her 30s, who had suffered serious arm and leg injuries.

Ambulance paramedics then continued her treatment before police cleared nearby Coogee Oval to facilitate the landing of a CareFlight rescue helicopter.

The woman was taken to hospital "semi-conscious and breathing," Surf Life Saving NSW said in a statement.

"We are sending our best wishes to the woman involved and her family at this time, after another terrible shark incident on our coastline," chief executive Steve Pearce said.

Nearby beaches from Bondi to Maroubra would remain closed for at least 24 hours, Surf Life Saving NSW said.

The incident underscored the need for stronger protections for beachgoers across the state, Central Coast local councillor Jared Wright said.

"Coogee Beach does not have an active SLSNSW drone patrol or shark listening station," he said in a statement.

"I have always been of the view that these protection measures need to be rolled out at as many beaches as possible, as quickly as possible."

Drones were being used at 14 locations statewide on Saturday but not at Coogee, SLNSW said.

Additional drone surveillance has been organised for Bondi and Bronte beaches for Saturday and Sunday, with further flights in the area to be assessed.

The most recent fatal attack in Australian waters happened on June 6, when 35‑year‑old diver Daniel Turpin was bitten by a suspected 4.5‑metre shark while spearfishing with his family off Michaelmas Island near Albany.

His death followed the killing of 38‑year‑old Perth father Steven Mattaboni off Rottnest Island on 16 May, and 39‑year‑old Queensland spearfisher Michael Jensz at Kennedy Shoal south of Cairns on May 24.

Both Western Australian attacks are believed to have involved great whites, while evidence points to Jensz having been taken by a bull shark.

In January, NSW made international headlines after recording four shark attacks in 48 hours.

Two resulted in people being hospitalised in critical condition, while the other two escaped without serious injuries.

title.en: 'Give us a chance': Why experience isn't enough for many migrants in Australia
title.zh: “给我们一个机会”：为什么在澳大利亚，经验对许多移民来说还不够

summary.en: Australia has welcomed one million refugees since World War Two, yet many face unemployment or underemployment despite their qualifications and experience.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚自二战以来已安置了一百万名难民，但其中许多人尽管拥有技能，却仍面临失业或就业不足的困境。

body.en:
When Natalia Akulova arrived in Australia as a refugee in 2022, she brought university degrees, years of professional experience, and hopes of rebuilding her career.

Days after arriving, the 36-year-old mother of two visited the Sydney Opera House, fulfilling a dream she had held while living in Ukraine.

This month, Akulova graduated from a pilot employment project run by the opera house, designed to help skilled refugees enter the workforce.

"The eight-week cadetship helped me build confidence in job interview skills and communicate with people," she tells SBS News.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

This week, Australia celebrates the one million refugees who have settled here since the end of World War Two.

The federal government's Humanitarian Program is set to remain at 20,000 places in 2026-27.

However, migration has become an increasingly contested political issue, with debates over housing affordability, infrastructure and population growth dominating public discourse.

The Opposition, led by Angus Taylor, has proposed capping net overseas migration at the number of new homes completed each year, arguing migration levels should be aligned with housing supply.

A recent opinion poll showed Pauline Hanson's One Nation party drawing ahead of the ruling Labor Party for the first time, with multiple surveys placing the populist party in the lead.

Professor Betina Szkudlarek and her research team at the University of Sydney Business School investigate the systemic challenges that skilled refugees face when seeking employment.

She says the shift in political sentiment could negatively affect those on humanitarian visas.

"I am concerned that, unfortunately, the current increasing anti-migration rhetoric will have a negative impact on refugees and refugee employment more broadly," Szkudlarek tells SBS News.

Szkudlarek says the debate's impact is also being felt in the labour market, where misconceptions about refugee workers persist among some employers.

She also points to growing challenges as some diversity and inclusion initiatives are being scaled back in parts of the corporate sector.

For many refugees, arriving in Australia marks not only a geographical shift but also a professional one.

Despite holding degrees and years of experience, many struggle to have their qualifications recognised, and often find themselves in jobs below their skill level and out of work altogether.

title.en: Five Great Reads: the new Pokémon Go, the creative possibilities of dementia, and a stampede for Kate Moss
title.zh: 五本精彩读物：新版 Pokémon Go、痴呆症的创意可能性以及 Kate Moss 的踩踏事件

summary.en: Guardian Australia’s weekend wrap of essential reads from the past seven days, selected by Emma Elsworthy Get this in your inbox every weekend. Sign up for Five Great Reads here Good morning. Please peruse these incredibly good stories, published this week. I’m Emma Elsworthy....
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Good morning. Please peruse these incredibly good stories, published this week. I’m Emma Elsworthy.

Caitlin Cassidy visited 50 payphones in a day to play a game, inspired by Pokémon Go, that has caused “a strange sense of connection in a small corner of the internet”. Our intrepid reporter encountered a dirty high chair, a broken-off manicured nail and pigeons feasting on … well, never mind.

But there was something touching about how PayphoneGo promotes exploration and community. And the voicemails – some of which can be listened to in the story – can be oddly poignant. “There are people talking about their favourite local areas, people talking about what they can see,” Brisbane student and creator Kris Norris says. “Sometimes people are venting. People are singing.”

Notable quote: “In my delirium, I start visiting the same payphones twice, sometimes three times. I pass others without noticing them, even though I have their location on a map.”

Further reading: An AI model trained on data collected from users of the game Pokémon Go will potentially help military drones find their location in war zones .

On a hunting trip in Mississippi in 1902, Theodore Roosevelt refused to shoot a bear that others had cornered, clubbed and tied to a tree. He told his team to shoot it instead. Oddly, the public loved this story, and a line of teddy bears was released. No other stuffed toy has come close to its popularity, though many tried – including the Billy Possum.

It’s one of the 100 items Roman Mars has chosen to summarise the US in 100 objects , along with the screw thread and a coin that sparked a gold crisis. Mars also chose a failed time capsule – itself an attempt to contain “objects to tell the story of our country”. Instead, as he tells it, “completely random and meaningless objects fell out”. How meta.

Notable quote: “It’s a humbling story about how hard it is to tell our own story and the impossible challenge of choosing objects to represent our history.”

Further reading: More weird North Americanness – sasquatch “sightings” have reignited fervour and scepticism about the ape-like beast.

When George Rook was diagnosed with dementia, he got three pieces of advice: “First, don’t take risks. Second, don’t get tired. Third, prepare.” What he wished he’d been told is: “socialise, keep active, learn new things, volunteer”. People with dementia – Australia’s leading cause of death – are routinely advised to disengage and prepare to die, as Anne Karpf writes.

But a group of four dementia rebels are taking on the the ageism and ableism by helping people see the “hopeful, creative possibilities” after a diagnosis. It’s an uplifting read about a debilitating illness with a simple idea driving changemakers: “How do we empower and enable people to live as...
body.zh: 早上好。请仔细阅读本周出版的这些令人难以置信的好故事。我是艾玛·埃尔斯沃西。 凯特琳·卡西迪 (Caitlin Cassidy) 一天内使用了 50 部公用电话来玩一款受 Pokémon Go 启发的游戏，这款游戏“在互联网的一个小角落里引发了一种奇怪的联系感”。我们勇敢的记者遇到了一把脏兮兮的高脚椅、一个剪断的修剪整齐的钉子和正在享用美食的鸽子……好吧，没关系。 但 PayphoneGo 如何促进探索和社区发展还是令人感动的。语音邮件——其中一些可以在故事中听到——可能会令人心酸。 “人们谈论他们最喜欢的当地地区，人们谈论他们所看到的东西，”布里斯班学生兼创作者克里斯·诺里斯说。 “有时人们在发泄。人们在唱歌。” 值得注意的引言：“在我的精神错乱中，我开始两次使用同一个公用电话，有时甚至三次。我经过其他人时没有注意到他们，即使我在地图上知道他们的位置。” 进一步阅读：根据 Pokémon Go 游戏用户收集的数据训练的人工智能模型将有可能帮助军用无人机在战区找到其位置。 1902 年，在密西西比州的一次狩猎之旅中，西奥多·罗斯福拒绝射杀一头被其他人逼到墙角、用棍棒殴打并绑在树上的熊。他告诉他的团队改为射击。奇怪的是，公众喜欢这个故事，一系列泰迪熊被发布。尽管许多人尝试过，包括比利负鼠，但没有其他毛绒玩具能与它的受欢迎程度相媲美。 这是罗马·马尔斯选择的 100 件物品之一，用 100 件物品来概括美国，其他物品还有螺纹和引发黄金危机的硬币。火星还选择了一个失败的时间胶囊——它本身就是试图容纳“讲述我们国家故事的物体”。相反，正如他所说，“完全随机且毫无意义的物体掉了出来”。多么元。 值得注意的引言：“这是一个令人谦卑的故事，讲述了讲述我们自己的故事是多么困难，以及选择代表我们历史的物品是不可能的挑战。” 进一步阅读：更奇怪的北美特征——大脚野人的“目击事件”重新点燃了人们对这种类人猿野兽的热情和怀疑。 当乔治·鲁克被诊断出患有痴呆症时，他得到了三条建议：“第一，不要冒险。第二，不要累。第三，做好准备。”他希望别人告诉他的是：“社交、保持活跃、学习新事物、做志愿者”。正如安妮·卡普夫（Anne Karpf）所写，痴呆症患者（澳大利亚的首要死因）通常被建议脱离接触并准备好死亡。 但由四名痴呆症反叛者组成的团体正在通过帮助人们在诊断后看到“充满希望、创造性的可能性”来应对年龄歧视和体能歧视。这是一本关于一种使人衰弱的疾病的令人振奋的读物，其中有一个推动变革者的简单想法：“我们如何赋予人们权力并让他们能够像……一样生活”

United States President Donald Trump once again claimed peace in the Middle East was near while also calling off planned strikes , helping fuel a rally in shares, as Elon Musk's long-awaited SpaceX float captivated investors around the world.

Meanwhile, Australians are feeling less confident about the economy as the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) prepares to meet next week.

Still, as a result of the announcement, the S&P/ASX 200 surged to a five-week high on Friday. In fact, it was the best one-day performance since April.

Matt Wacher, chief investment officer at Jana Investment Advisers, told SBS On The Money that it's difficult to discern what is an actual signal of a peace deal and what is noise.

However, following a few poor days for the markets, he said Trump's remarks helped shift sentiment and added to the excitement surrounding SpaceX’s market debut.

Musk’s SpaceX has listed on the Nasdaq and will start trading on Saturday AEST (Friday local time).

The company raised US$75 billion ($106 billion) by selling 555.56 million shares at US$135 ($191) a piece, valuing it at US$1.77 trillion ($2.5 trillion).

That makes it the biggest market debut since Saudi Aramco in 2019 — but is the hype worth it?

Some analysts say it's overvalued. Morningstar, for example, values the company at US$780 billion ($1.1 billion) overall, or US$63 ($89.4) a share.

There are other concerns, too, including the company’s lack of profitability and the concentration of power. Musk maintains about 40 per cent of SpaceX's total equity, which gives him more than 84 per cent of the voting power.

While only 4 per cent of the company has been put on the market, many people will get some exposure through super funds that track the US market.

According to the Westpac-Melbourne Institute Consumer Sentiment Survey for June, property is losing its appeal.

In fact, just 4.5 per cent of the 1,200 respondents think it is a wise place to invest.

That's the lowest reading in the survey's 52-year history and well below the historical average of 24 per cent.

That's as overall consumer confidence fell to 80.6. Anything below 100 suggests that pessimists outnumber optimists in their perceptions of the economy and their finances.

The survey is closely watched by the RBA, leaving the board with much to consider at its meeting next week.

The broad expectation is that the board will leave the official cash rate on hold at 4.35 per cent.
